_about: Denial Intelligence seed (E3). `disputes` is the working layer over a request that needs a payer-decision response; request.stage stays the only lifecycle and the dispute status is derived from it (web/js/shared/sel/disputes.js, reconciled after every action by server/psyflo/actions/x-disputes.js). `dispute_evidence` are dated records the workspace reads (synthetic, provenance 'seed': shown as Illustrative sample). `drafting_rules` is the list of rules Psyflo applies to every draft (read by Settings and the payer guidance drawer). Synthetic data only.

drafting_rules.title: Dates within the last 30 days
drafting_rules.text: anything offered as current evidence; older facts carry their date

drafting_rules.title: Counts, never percentages
drafting_rules.text: "3 of 5 escalations", "6 dated occasions (Oct 2, 6, 9, 14, 20, 22)": the forms ask that way

drafting_rules.title: Frequency, duration, intensity
drafting_rules.text: for every behaviour named (2 to 3 times a week · 5 to 20 min · moderate)

drafting_rules.title: Interventions named from Harvest's list
drafting_rules.text: with why it was used (movement for regulation), not just that it happened

drafting_rules.title: Every note names an ISP objective
drafting_rules.text: and states progress as a count

drafting_rules.title: No "observed"
drafting_rules.text: direct-support notes say what the staffer did ("worked with", "prompted", "used")

drafting_rules.title: Prior services carry provider, dates and outcome
drafting_rules.text: an empty outcome blocks the draft and asks the question; "information about outpatient" and pro-bono contacts do not count as prior care

drafting_rules.title: School counseling goes under care coordination
drafting_rules.text: never as the failed prior service

drafting_rules.title: Criterion 3 is left blank when 1 and 2 are met
drafting_rules.text: two of three is enough; the panel says so

drafting_rules.title: Nothing the clinician marked exclude
drafting_rules.text: and nothing from the family that is not on the form's question; household disclosures stay out unless the clinician presses Include

drafting_rules.title: Trauma-informed care and the admission decision are never drafted
drafting_rules.text: Psyflo notes when the section was discussed and leaves the box to the clinician

drafting_rules.title: Answer the question and stop
drafting_rules.text: on information requests: three items asked, three answered, nothing added

drafting_rules.title: Vary language across days
drafting_rules.text: if a staffer's last 30 notes share a paragraph, the enhancer varies it and the supervisor sees the pattern

drafting_rules.title: Quiet day rule
drafting_rules.text: a day with nothing to report says what was maintained and what still needed staff presence
